analysis.session_summary: CHF and USD led the board while SPX fell 0.357% and VIX rose 0.61%, leaving the tape risk-off. Brent gained 0.804% to 107.632 after the Saudi pipeline outage, and USD/MXN rose 1367.4 pips on EM stress. The late Trump comment that Iran wants a deal triggered sharp retracements in EUR/USD, USD/JPY, Brent and EM pairs, but the legs otherwise had no single clear catalyst. Event reactions for Canada CPI and ECB President Lagarde were muted, inside the noise floor.

themes.evidence: CHF +0.361% and USD +0.285% vs majors; EUR/CHF -38.4 pips, USD/CHF -5.5 pips despite Dollar strength; SPX -0.357%, VIX +0.61%.

themes.theme: Oil supply shock from Saudi pipeline
themes.evidence: Brent +85.8 pips to 107.632; headline: Saudi oil pipeline hit and mostly out of service for weeks; USD/MXN +1367.4 pips, USD/ZAR +883.3 pips.
Trump: Iran wants to make a deal comment at 15:45; EUR/USD +35.0 pips, USD/JPY -59.7 pips, Brent -359.0 pips in the final leg.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD fell -71.7 pips over most of the window and retraced +35.0 pips on the Iran headline, closing -39.5 pips.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: USD/JPY rallied +154.2 pips into 15:45 and gave back -59.7 pips on the Iran comment, still closing +60.8 pips.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: GBP/USD dropped -51.9 pips then bounced +37.7 pips late, ending -17.8 pips.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: USD/CHF chopped through multiple small legs and closed only -5.5 pips despite an earlier +36.6 pip rally, showing CHF resilience.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: USD/CAD rose +60.5 pips through 15:45 and retraced -22.2 pips, still closing +39.3 pips.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: AUD/USD fell -60.3 pips then recovered +34.2 pips, net -28.8 pips.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: NZD/USD dropped -55.5 pips and retraced +27.3 pips, closing -29.2 pips.

polarity_reads.read: Actual matched forecast at -0.1%; CAD basket moved only 0.008%, inside the noise floor. This says positioning was balanced and no CAD repricing signal came from the data.
EUR basket moved -0.008%, inside the noise floor; no new policy signal, so EUR positioning was not challenged.
EUR basket moved 0.000%; the speech was a non-event for FX and implies no acute EUR sensitivity to Lagarde.

scenarios.name: De-escalation drift / risk recovery extends
scenarios.thesis: The late Trump Iran comment reduces the oil risk premium; last-leg reversals in EUR/USD, USD/JPY, Brent and EM pairs extend as no new escalation appears.
triggers: No new Saudi or Gulf escalation headlines
scenarios.invalidation: New pipeline or Gulf escalation, or Brent closing back above 107.632

pair_paths.rationale: Measured late bounce of +35.0 pips on the Iran headline
Late USD/JPY giveback was -59.7 pips on the same de-escalation headline
Cable late bounce was +37.7 pips on risk recovery

scenarios.name: Risk-off persistence / CHF and USD strength continue
scenarios.thesis: Despite late Iran comments, safe-haven demand remains intact: CHF and USD lead, high-beta and EM currencies stay offered.
triggers: Oil supply outage headlines continue to dominate
scenarios.invalidation: A confirmed Iran deal or sharp Brent reversal below 107.632

pair_paths.rationale: Measured net EUR/USD decline of -39.5 pips from USD strength
USD/CHF closed -5.5 pips, consistent with CHF outperforming even a strong USD
USD/MXN +1367.4 pips reflects EM stress under risk-off

scenarios.name: UK data surprise strengthens GBP
scenarios.thesis: A positive UK Claimant Count or Average Earnings surprise triggers a GBP repricing, with cable extending late bounce and EUR/GBP lower.
triggers: Claimant Count below 8.3K or Average Earnings above 3.9%
GBP strength vs USD and EUR
scenarios.invalidation: In-line data or soft earnings; Claimant Count above forecast

pair_paths.rationale: Late GBP/USD bounce of +37.7 pips can extend on strong data
EUR/GBP net move was -17.8 pips; stronger GBP extends this

risks.risk: Saudi pipeline outage keeps oil risk premium alive
risks.why_it_matters: Brent +0.804% and headline says pipeline repairs take several weeks; this pressures oil importers and supports USD/CHF and EM FX stress.

risks.risk: Trump Iran diplomacy headline can reverse quickly
risks.why_it_matters: The 15:45 comment drove EUR/USD +35.0, USD/JPY -59.7 and Brent -359.0; reversal risk is two-sided.
risks.watch: Confirmation or denial of Iran engagement

risks.why_it_matters: Large ranges such as CHF/JPY 175.3 pips and sharp reversals show headline sensitivity in illiquid conditions.
risks.watch: Opening gap risk in Asia and early Europe

risks.why_it_matters: Claimant Count and Average Earnings at 08:00 are the only high-impact calendar items and can move GBP crosses.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: The only scheduled high-impact releases are UK Claimant Count at 08:00 (forecast 8.3K, previous -11.0K) and Average Earnings 3m/y (forecast 3.9%, previous 4.1%). A surprise there can shift GBP and risk tone; otherwise the tape stays headline-driven on Iran and oil.
